integrity: The proof reduces the full element-pair covering LP to exact singleton and pair resolving-neighborhood constraints. The complete-graph pair system then gives a closed lower bound by summation and uniqueness by equality in all pair constraints. A separate checker reconstructs every original constraint and solves the unreduced LP, including coordinate ranges on the optimum face.
scientific_limitations: The quantity studied is the canonical continuous relaxation of the published binary mixed-metric formulation; lambda_M is notation introduced locally for that relaxation, not claimed as standard terminology.
The closed form and optimizer classification are proved for double fan graphs only.
The integer values used for comparison are prior literature results; the originality claim is the continuous optimum, unique optimizer, and integrality gap.
Finite numerical verification through n=20 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude an unindexed optimization treatment using different terminology.
title: Exact LP relaxation and near-two integrality gap for mixed metric dimension of double fans
